meta.title: Novel Fanfic Studio
meta.description: Import the original and you have a fanfic reference library of your own: relationships, plot history and world rules, always at hand. The fates, relationships and plot you want to change are recorded as Fic Canon. While writing, keep knowledge, timeline and scene details straight; after writing, check OOC, canon conflicts and continuity. The original is only a reference — your story is yours to decide.
